mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and increase the attractiveness of equities over fixed income.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as corporate earnings face headwinds from reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 300), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market views the tightening as effective in curbing inflation without triggering a recession.
failure_condition: In instances with CPIAUCSL > 300, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as the market prices in reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 decline by more than 0.5% in the past quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 50,000 signals weak labor market growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth < 50,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 signals a housing market slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as the market reacts quickly to reduced construction activity and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
